import numpy as np
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import scipy.ndimage as ndimage

def _objs(A,col):
    lab,n=ndimage.label(A==col)
    return [[(int(r),int(c)) for r,c in np.argwhere(lab==i)] for i in range(1,n+1)]

def _canon(o):
    r0=min(r for r,c in o); c0=min(c for r,c in o)
    s=[[0]*(max(c for r,c in o)-c0+1) for _ in range(max(r for r,c in o)-r0+1)]
    for r,cc in o: s[r-r0][cc-c0]=1
    return tuple(map(tuple,s))

def _corner_of(o):
    cells=set(o)
    for r,c in cells:
        hn=int((r,c-1) in cells)+int((r,c+1) in cells)
        vn=int((r-1,c) in cells)+int((r+1,c) in cells)
        if hn and vn and hn+vn==2: return (r,c)
    return None

def transform(grid):
    A=np.array(grid)
    bg=Counter(A.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    allc={int(c):_objs(A,c) for c in sorted(set(A.flatten())) if c!=bg}
    ac,ao,vc=None,None,None
    for c,ol in allc.items():
        if len(ol)!=1: continue
        o=ol[0]; cr=_corner_of(o)
        if cr is None or len(o)<6: continue
        vert=sum(1 for r,cc in o if cc==cr[1]); horz=sum(1 for r,cc in o if r==cr[0])
        if vert>=3 and horz>=3 and vert+horz-1==len(o):
            ac,ao,vc=c,o,cr
    arm=[cc for cc in ao if cc[0]==vc[0]]  # horizontal arm of the arrow
    shapes=defaultdict(list)
    for c,ol in allc.items():
        for ob in ol: shapes[_canon(ob)].append(ob)
    best=None; target=None
    for s,lst in shapes.items():
        if len(lst)!=2: continue
        o1,o2=lst
        md=lambda ob: min(abs(r-ar)+abs(c-ac2) for r,c in ob for ar,ac2 in arm)
        d1,d2=md(o1),md(o2)
        near,far=min(d1,d2),max(d1,d2)
        if best is None or (near,-len(o1))<best:
            best=(near,-len(o1)); target=o1 if d1>d2 else o2
    B=A.copy()
